newsitem.title: USA: U.S. durable goods orders surprisingly strong in February.
newsitem.headline: U.S. durable goods orders surprisingly strong in February.

text.p: Orders for costly manufactured goods posted a surprisingly strong gain last month, hitting record levels after a robust January, the Commerce Department said on Wednesday.

New orders for durable goods climbed 1.5 percent in February to a seasonally adjusted record $178.3 billion -- sharply contrary to Wall Street economists'expectations that orders would weaken by 0.4 percent.
